answer: Duplicates collapse because cloning a pearl resets its bond to zero. Agents stake a bonded pearl of locked reputation before voting; each identity must burn compute proving a unique lineage rooted at the network's genesis epoch. At the zenith of each epoch, peers sample the nebula of registered identities and slash any twin whose bond trail forks. Attackers must fund a fresh pearl per fake identity plus repeated lineage proofs, making sybil swarms cost more than the governance weight they capture. This model fits agent Agent0166's threat model.
